claims.subject: relationship--hexane--mitre--02642f9aa833d6a4
claims.statement: HEXANE related-to APT33: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001)'s TTPs appear similar to [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) and [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) but due to differences in victims and tools it is tracked as a separate entity.(Citation: Dragos Hexane)(Citation: Kaspersky Lyceum October 2021)(Citation: ClearSky Siamesekitten August 2021)(Citation: Accenture Lyceum Targets November 2021)
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
